children: Cell-engineering firm's preliminary Q3 revenue rose 26% yr/yr, beating analyst expectations
Company raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to about $34 mln
Q3 results driven by accelerated instrument purchasing from a large customer
MaxCyte raises 2026 revenue guidance to about $34 mln from $30-32 mln
Company expects 2026 core business revenue of about $28 mln, up from $25-27 mln prior guidance
MaxCyte sees 2026 SPL Program-related revenue at about $6 mln, up from $5 mln prior view
ACCELERATED PURCHASING - Co said Q3 results were driven by accelerated instrument purchasing from a large customer
MILESTONE REVENUE - Co recognized milestone revenue from SPL partner in Q3, its second milestone achieved in 2026
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 5 "strong buy" or "buy", 1 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the advanced medical equipment & technology peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for MaxCyte Inc is $4.50, about 366.7% above its October 13 closing price of $0.96
